theorem.gauge_kernel: For x=(u,s) in C2 plus C, the stacked production-frame kernel is span_R{(iu,0),(0,is)} on the generic stratum; at s=0 the whole singlet plane joins the doublet phase, and at u=0 the frame is zero. No fixed-rank inverse exists.
theorem.differentiated_gauge: For either local phase generator J_alpha, E_r=M_r(z+a)-M_r(z)-DM_r(z)[a] satisfies E_r^T J_alpha(z+a)=-DM_r(z)[a]^T J_alpha a. The R-071 fixture is exactly the doublet phase direction.
theorem.inverse_free_completion: A tau-regularized completion inverts only theta T^*QT+tau I and retains a 1-theta fraction of the terminal square. The Cameron-Martin cost must supply tau on gauge directions.
theorem.local_bound: The nonlinear derivative-displacement vector k=sum_r E_r Q_II M_r(z)^T y obeys |k|<=C_*|a|^2|y| uniformly in the fixed positive floor, with C_*=24||Q_II||op(sqrt(34)+4sqrt(2))=1.5397534378598672.
theorem.diagonal_one_use: For whole-shell predictable a_j=K_j h_j, the matched same-shell leakage is bounded after one sequence Holder and one weighted AM-GM step by eta X+zeta_d Y_d+R_infty/(432 eta^3 zeta_d^2). R_infty is one cutoff-independent random constant, not one constant per shell.
theorem.sixth_moment_tail: If C_D N_j bounds the full 18-real-component derivative covariance trace and C_nabla is the full-gradient smoothing constant, E R_infty<=15 L^3(C_*C_nabla)^6 C_D^3(8/7)N_j0^-3. Before terminal-sextic retuning the expected Young remainder coefficient is 5/126.
theorem.terminal_sextic: The actual sharp-cube Littlewood-Paley constant is retained. With zeta_d=zeta/(alpha C_LP^6), the single cutoff-independent remainder is alpha^2 C_LP^12 R_infty/(432 eta^3 zeta^2)+zeta C_alpha U_*/alpha, where U_*=int sup_J |U_J|^6 is integrable by Doob.
theorem.causalization: Replacing terminal G by strict-past G_j is an exact expectation identity after conditioning on future same-point values. It is not pathwise or global value-derivative independence and does not apply to within-shell feedback.
theorem.off_diagonal_reduction: For a high block based at z_0=U+A_<j0, E_tot=sum_j E_j+sum_{k<j}F_kj and the terminal leakage equals the matched diagonal plus the explicit three-family off-diagonal remainder O. An independent production fixture has |O|/|diagonal|>4087, so O is load-bearing.
theorem.sobolev_discriminator: A generic root payment obeys ||A^2 DA||_{H^sigma}<=C X^((1+sigma)/2)Y^((2-sigma)/6). It leaves a random-constant exponent only for sigma<1/2; an H^{-1/2-delta} root needs causal gain gamma>delta and moment 3/(gamma-delta).

successor: Prove a largest-shell triangular two-parameter Carleson estimate for the exact off-diagonal remainder, or an exact cancellation returning it to the R-069 control/mixed telescope, while retaining the terminal range square and avoiding double use of the R-071 linear payment. Then perform finite-energy extension, controlled-shell one-use, and Nelson synthesis.
honesty_boundary: This scoped T4 continuation proves the exact gauge-kernel strata, differentiated gauge identity, inverse-free regularized completion, and the matched strict-past same-shell diagonal one-use estimate with one cutoff-independent integrable random constant and O(N_j0^-3) sixth-moment tail. It also proves the exact nonzero terminal off-diagonal remainder and a quantitative Sobolev discriminator. It does not control or cancel that off-diagonal remainder, close the integrated nonlinear kernel theorem, extend to every finite-energy drift, prove controlled-shell one-use or the q=10/9 Nelson theorem, construct an interacting measure, remove the floor or regulator, take infinite volume, or justify T5, T6, or T7.
